items.source: Create a new HttpMessageConverters instance with the specified additional converters.
items.translation: 创建一个新的HttpMessageConverters实例，并指定额外的转换器。

items.source: Create a new HttpMessageConverters instance with the specified converters.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 HttpMessageConverters 实例，使用指定的转换器。

items.source: additionalConverters - additional converters to be added. Items are added just before any default converter of the same type (or at the front of the list if no default converter is found). The postProcessConverters(List) method can be used for further converter manipulation.
items.translation: additionalConverters - 要添加的附加转换器。元素会在同类型的任何默认转换器之前添加（如果在列表中没有找到默认转换器，则添加到列表开头）。postProcessConverters(List) 方法可用于进一步的转换器操作。

items.source: converters - a mutable list of the converters that will be used.
items.translation: converters - 一个将被使用的转换器的可变列表。

items.source: the final converts list to use
items.translation: 最终将列表转换为供使用

items.source: Method that can be used to post-process the HttpMessageConverter list before it is used to configure the part converters of AllEncompassingFormHttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 可用于在将 HttpMessageConverter 列表用于配置 AllEncompassingFormHttpMessageConverter 的部件转换器之前对其进行后处理的

items.source: Method that can be used to post-process the HttpMessageConverter list before it is used.
items.translation: 可用于在HttpMessageConverter列表被使用之前对其进行后处理的方法。

items.source:
Return an immutable list of the converters in the order that they will be
registered.
items.translation: 返回一个不可变的转换器列表，顺序为它们将被注册的顺序。

items.source: An instance of this bean can be registered with specific additional converters if needed, otherwise default converters will be used.
NOTE: The default converters used are the same as standard Spring MVC (see WebMvcConfigurationSupport) with some slight re-ordering to put XML converters at the back of the list.
since 4.0 in favor of ClientHttpMessageConvertersCustomizer and ServerHttpMessageConvertersCustomizer.
iterator in interface Iterable<HttpMessageConverter<?>>

converters - converters to be added. Items are added just before any default converter of the same type (or at the front of the list if no default converter is found). The postProcessConverters(List) method can be used for further converter manipulation.
items.translation: converters - 要添加的转换器。项会在同类型的任何默认转换器之前添加（如果未找到默认转换器，则添加到列表开头）。postProcessConverters(List) 方法可用于进一步的转换器操作。
